YOU...

- support the development of certification and airworthiness strategies for unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) within the EASA Specific Category, taking SORA, SAIL, Operational Safety Objectives, and applicable Means of Compliance into account
- derive, analyze, and structure certification and compliance requirements based on regulatory frameworks, authority publications, guidance material, and project-specific assumptions

- ideally have experience with Git, SharePoint, or comparable documentation and collaboration tools
- ideally have worked with Polarion, Siemens Teamcenter, or similar requirements management and PLM systems
- possess excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken; German language skills are considered an advantage

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us.

At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. And the foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and nurtures a culture grounded in integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust.

We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

Who will you join?

Group Compliance - Investigations
About the role

Allianz Group Compliance is evolving its investigations function toward a more integrated, increasingly technology- and AI-enabled operating model. We are at the beginning of that journey. The primary requirement for this role remains hands-on experience in complex investigations. In addition, the role holder will help shape how the function adopts investigative technology and AI - pragmatically, and in a responsible, human-led way. We welcome candidates from an investigations, IT-forensics or legal-tech background who combine strong investigative capability with a genuine interest in developing this area.

How can you make an impact?

As an Investigator / Investigation Counsel, your responsibilities will include:

Investigations

- Member of the rapid-reaction task force to lead investigations on ad hoc Compliance issues
- Assess, prioritize, execute and lead complex compliance investigations
- Collaborate with Regions / Global Lines / other entities on delegated investigations
- Provide expert guidance and support to Compliance Officers at local, regional and global levels
- Monitor, follow-up and escalate issues as necessary, ensuring resolution and compliance
- Make effective use of investigative technology and, as it is introduced, AI-enabled methods (e.g. e-discovery, data analytics) to work efficiently and at scale, keeping human judgment at the centre
- Continuously enhance and share insights and lessons learned

Governance

- Develop and implement governance frameworks to support effective investigation processes
Review and update policies related to internal investigations and whistleblowing to ensure alignment with industry standards
Contribute to the further development of the investigations operating model, including the responsible integration of technology and AI as the setup matures  *  Provide guidance on governance issues related to internal investigations and whistleblowing to enhance organizational integrity

Awareness

- Contribute to initiatives aimed at elevating the awareness and effectiveness of the Whistleblowing program

Reporting

- Ensure comprehensive and accurate data entry into the Compliance Case Management Tool (CCMT)
- Develop and present detailed reports and presentations on Compliance investigations and related topics to senior management
- Analyze case data and CCMT usage to identify trends, providing strategic insights and reports where required
- Prepare responses to media requests and provide input to Sustainability reports, Audits and other similar / related information requests

Integrity Committee

- Fulfill obligations under the Integrity Committee Terms of Reference (both ad hoc and standing committees)
- Prepare and present Integrity Committee reports and minutes

What are you made of?

Minimum Qualifications

- Solid experience (3+ years) and proven competence in conducting and, increasingly, leading complex investigations effectively and efficiently, ideally with international exposure
- Strong expertise in remediation and mitigation measures in an international and multicultural environment
- Exceptional ability to communicate clearly and constructively with all levels, including senior management, within a multicultural organization
- Proven ability to learn, acquire and apply new knowledge and skills in digital and investigative methodologies, laws and regulations

Preferred Qualifications

- In-depth knowledge of the insurance business is an advantage
- Some practical, operational experience with investigative technology - e.g. e-discovery, data analytics, IT forensics or legal-tech tools - whether gained as an investigator, IT-forensics specialist or legal-technology professional
- Interest in helping build an AI-enabled investigation capability, with a pragmatic and responsible view of where technology adds real value;
- Strong communication and report-writing skills (fluent English required; additional languages a plus)
- Results-driven team player
- Willingness to work across time zones and travel internationally
- Strategic and innovative approach to working in a governance function
- High level of confidentiality and discretion
- Previous experience in insurance or asset management business functions, consulting, digital / tech is a plus
- Experience applying ChatGPT, Generative AI, and Ethical AI solution

Do we have what you need?

- Flexible and hybrid work model

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As Team Lead for Function Controlling (f/m/d) within the SE FIN GS BC SO organisation, you will be at the forefront of acting as business partner for SE GS Solution Functions. Your role will involve driving financial performance and supporting strategic decision-making across the Solution organization of SE GS. Your primary focus will be on optimizing cost controlling processes by implementing AI and Dash solutions, ensuring effective budget planning, and providing insightful analysis of forecasts and actuals. You will lead a global team, coaching and developing team members to achieve their full potential.
Each day, your leadership will strengthen financial performance and enhance accountability across all functions of Solution business.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Lead the financial performance management of cost centres by preparing, consolidating, and analysing forecasts, budgets, and monthly closings
* Act as a business partner by conducting reasonable analyses of key financial drivers for cost centres, delivering clear financial reports that include deviation analyses and actionable performance insights
* Implement and oversee standardized processes and automation initiatives, leverage AI where applicable to streamline operations.
* Develop and implement dashboards that provide real-time insights into cost centre performance and manpower utilization
* Collaborate with various functions to address complex setup topics, accounting questions, and reporting issues, ensuring reliable financial steering and alignment with organizational goals

What You Bring

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field
* Extensive experience in financial controlling, FP&A, budgeting, and corporate finance within a complex business environment
* Proven leadership capabilities in developing and managing teams of experienced finance professionals
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive business decisions
* Excellent knowledge of SAP applications, financial reporting, internal controls, and process improvement within a global matrix organization
* Fluent English communication skills; German is beneficial for collaboration within the local business environment 

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

EMEA Infrastructure Development team is seeking a Senior Project Controller to provide independent oversight of project cost performance across the EMEA Real Estate portfolio partnering with Construction Project Managers, Design, Procurement, and Finance. You will help shift the organization from ad-hoc cost tracking to a structured, transparent controls partnership, improving forecast accuracy, spend visibility, and execution quality while regional teams stay focused on delivery.

What You’ll Do

- Track approved budgets, commitments, expenditures, and invoiced costs across the portfolio
- Preparation of portfolio-level cost performance reviews and reporting for leadership
- Support change management - change orders, scope changes, pricing review - and help keep spending aligned with approved scope and budgets
- Help identify and escalate cost, scope, and delivery
- Support KPI tracking, portfolio reporting validation, and standardized project/executive reporting (dashboards, Power BI, status reports)
- Support data quality, master data alignment, and dashboard governance across regional project data
- Act as a key stakeholder during ATP (Authorization to Proceed) and major project gate reviews
- Support milestone tracking and schedule visibility where needed; extended planning ownership may expand as the function develops
- Help establish controlling function as it scales - scope, deliverables, processes, and collaboration models with regional teams and HQ
- Pilot and refine approaches, act as a trusted partner to regional teams, reducing PM reporting burden so they can focus on delivery

What You’ll Bring

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, or equivalent experience
- 5+ years in project controls, cost management, budgeting, and forecast analysis — preferably in retail, commercial, or multi-site infrastructure environments

jobs.description:
What to Expect

The EMEA Infrastructure Development team is seeking a Senior Cost Estimator to serve as the subject matter expert in construction cost estimating across Tesla's EMEA portfolio, including Service Centers, Retail Stores, Delivery Hubs, and Non-SSD sites (R&D, Training, Offices, etc.) You will drive the transition from decentralized regional estimating to a centralized EMEA-wide approach — defining the methodology, standards, templates, and governance for how projects are evaluated. You will deliver independent, reliable construction cost estimates at every project stage, giving project teams, designers, procurement, and leadership a trusted reference for go/no-go decisions.

What You’ll Do

- Develop cost estimates from Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM) through detailed CapEx budgets, with accuracy appropriate to each project stage (AACE estimate classes as reference framework)
- Produce high-level estimates based on historic data to support go/no-go decisions against key cost metrics
- Analyze plans, Due diligence reports and interpret designs; perform dimensional quantity take-offs; identify scope implied but not explicitly shown in design documents
- Develop and manage a Basis of Estimate for each project — scope, execution strategy, precision level, assumptions, exclusions, risks, and critical information
- Lead value engineering at early design stages, providing cost-driven feedback and recommendations to designers
- Visit project sites as required to validate scope, site conditions, and constraints in support of estimation — working from assumptions and scope definition provided by the Project Manager, Real Estate team and design team
- Support the Procurement and PMs with contractor pricing validation and bid leveling to ensure we are receiving good value for spends
- Contribute to continuous improvement of estimating processes
- Maintain and update the cost database, ensuring pricing reflects current market conditions, inflation, transport costs, and regional differentiation
- Deliver accurate, independently validated estimates to support ATP and go/no-go decisions; review outputs against historic pricing and regional benchmarks
- Provide expert input to Procurement on sourcing and pricing for atypical works or high cost-variance items

What You’ll Bring

- Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, or related field — or equivalent professional experience
- 5+ years as a senior specialist or SME in project cost estimating, preferably in retail, commercial, industrial, or multi-site infrastructure rollout environments
- Practical knowledge of construction means and methods across civil, structural, architectural, MEP disciplines with the ability to translate technical knowledge into accurate, defensible cost advice
- Solid understanding of CapEx cost estimating from ROM through detailed CapEx budgeting; proven experience with quantity take-offs and design document interpretation
- Experience maintaining or developing pricing databases or cost libraries at a portfolio or multi-country level
- Ability of identifying main risks especially during ROM which could significantly impact the costs in a later stage
- Analytical, detail-oriented, and self-motivated; proactive communicator in a fast-paced, multicultural environment
- Experience building, leading, or transitioning to a centralized estimating function — methodology, SOPs, and standardization frameworks
- Proven track record as the go-to cost expert for project teams, designers, and leadership; authoritative cost advice with confidence, independence, and sound professional judgement
- Availability to travel across EMEA as required (up to 50%)
- English required; additional European language skills a strong plus

jobs.occupation: PhD Candidate in Functional Genomics and Pancreatic Cancer Research; part time 65%  (m/w/d) (Forschungsreferent/in)
jobs.description:
Scope of duties

· Work on the project “Global mapping of drug synergy landscapes using massively parallel Cas13d genetic interaction screening” within the German Cancer Aid-funded DEFEAT-PDAC consortium
· Investigate therapeutically relevant genetic dependencies and drug combinations in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
· Perform and analyze high-throughput genetic interaction screens, particularly using Cas13d-based screening approaches
· Plan and conduct molecular and cell biological experiments to validate identified targets and drug synergies
· Investigate rational combination therapies, including combinations with RAS/KRAS inhibitors
· Work with pancreatic cancer cell lines and additional preclinical model systems
· Apply modern methods in cell biology, molecular biology, functional genomics and proteomics
· Quantitatively analyze, interpret and document experimental data
· Collaborate closely with research groups and technology platforms within the DEFEAT-PDAC network
· Present research findings at project meetings and scientific conferences and contribute to scientific publications

Our requirements

· A successfully completed university degree, preferably a Master’s degree or equivalent, in biology, biochemistry, molecular medicine, biotechnology or a related life-science discipline
· Strong interest in cancer biology, functional genomics, mechanisms of therapy resistance and translational cancer research
· Practical experience in cell and molecular biology, for example mammalian cell culture, transfection, RNA and protein analysis, immunoblotting or microscopy
· Previous experience with CRISPR-based technologies, genetic screens, proteomics, next-generation sequencing or bioinformatic data analysis is an advantage, but not mandatory
· Motivation to learn new experimental technologies and quantitative analysis methods
· A careful, structured and independent approach to scientific work
· Scientific curiosity, high motivation and enthusiasm for experimental research
· Strong communication and teamwork skills and an interest in working in an interdisciplinary and international research environment
· Very good written and spoken English
· German language skills are not required

Our offer

· An innovative and challenging PhD project within the DEFEAT-PDAC consortium, a national and internationally connected research network funded by German Cancer Aid

· An international and interdisciplinary research environment at the interface of cancer biology, functional genomics, proteomics and clinical translation
· State-of-the-art laboratories and access to advanced screening, proteomics, sequencing and data-analysis platforms
· Close collaboration with basic scientists, bioinformaticians and clinician scientists
· Structured scientific supervision and support for your professional and personal development
· Opportunities to participate in national and international conferences, workshops and training programmes
· A collaborative, supportive and inspiring working environment that encourages scientific independence and the development of your own ideas
· Employment according to the German public-sector collective agreement, including annual leave and additional benefits in accordance with the applicable regulations
· The position is initially funded for three years. Subject to a positive scientific re-evaluation, an extension for up to two additional years is possible
· The position is based at the LMU University Hospital, Campus Großhadern, in Munich
· The remuneration is based on the Collective Agreement for the Public Service of the Federal States (TV-Ärzte) including all allowances customary in the public service.
